'''Trace''' was a part of the [[Deadeyes]] [[Republic Army]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]].

When the Deadeyes allowed themselves to be captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]], Trace and some fellow Deadeyes were sent to a labor camp in [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Trace didn't survive and died from the cold.
